info.name: Stack Overflow for Teams Answers Search API

params.name: site
params.description: Stack Exchange site identifier (use stackoverflow for Stack Overflow)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number (1-indexed)

params.name: pagesize
params.description: Number of results per page (max 100)

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order

params.name: sort
params.description: Field to sort results by

params.name: intitle
params.description: Text that must appear in question titles

params.name: tagged
params.description: Semicolon-delimited list of tags to filter by

params.name: nottagged
params.description: Semicolon-delimited tags to exclude from results

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter to control which fields are returned

items.docs: Searches Stack Overflow questions by title text, tags, and exclusion tags. At least one of intitle, tagged, or nottagged must be specified.

items.docs: Performs an advanced search of Stack Overflow questions with filters for acceptance status, answer count, body text, closure status, tags, user, view count, and wiki status.

items.docs: Returns questions similar to a given title. Useful for finding existing answers before posting a new question.
